messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Restyle the person's hair to match the hairstyle shown in the reference images, using the front view for the front-facing shape and the back view for the back-facing shape. Transfer only the hairstyle; do not adopt the reference person's facial features, hair color, or clothing. Preserve the person's original hair color and all other elements of the current video.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please restyle the person's hair according to the reference images. Only transfer the hairstyle from the reference images, not the reference person's facial features, hair color, or clothing. Preserve everything else in the current video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands on a rooftop, turning her body and head while posing with one hand on her hip and the other raised near her face.","camera":"A medium full shot from a low angle that slowly pushes in and tracks slightly as the character turns.","clothing":"A white off-the-shoulder top with a pink gingham bodice, a long white skirt or duster, and bright green sneakers.","hair_color":"Light brown.","hairstyle":"Light brown hair pulled up into a high bun with a few loose strands framing the face.","identity":"A 3D-rendered female character with dark skin and a slim build.","scene":"An outdoor city rooftop at dusk, surrounded by tall buildings with illuminated windows, Japanese signage, and construction cranes in the background."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The character's hair changed from a single high ponytail to two high buns, matching the reference hairstyle. The hair remains light brown, and the character's clothing, pose, rooftop scene, and camera movement appear otherwise consistent.
arguments.requested_change: Restyle the character's hair to the reference double-bun hairstyle, transferring only the hairstyle while preserving the original hair color, face, clothing, and scene.
uncertain: Whether the back-facing shape exactly matches the reference in all frames is difficult to verify from the provided frames.
